snippet.description:
Learn how to find the area of Cartesian curves, loops, cycloid, and common region between two curves step-by-step for B.Sc. Maths and university exams.

Is video me hum Integral Calculus ke Quadrature topic ke important solved examples detail me discuss karenge. Agar aap B.Sc. 1st Year, Rajasthan University ya kisi bhi university exam ki preparation kar rahe hain, toh ye lecture aapke concepts clear karne ke liye bohot helpful hoga.

Topics covered in this video:
👉 Area of loop of Cartesian curve ($ay^2 = x^2(a-x)$)
👉 Area bounded by curve and its asymptote
👉 Area of cycloid bounded by its base
👉 Common area between two intersecting curves (Parabola & Circle)
👉 Limits of integration & Beta-Gamma function substitution tricks

Timestamps
00:00 - Introduction & Quadrature Basics Recap
02:12 - Example 1: Area of the Loop ($ay^2 = x^2(a - x)$)
07:55 - Example 1: Integration & Gamma Function Evaluation
13:03 - Example 2: Area of Curve $x(x^2 + y^2) = a(x^2 - y^2)$
18:15 - Example 2: Area of the Loop Calculation
23:12 - Example 2: Area Between the Curve & Its Asymptote ($x = -a$)
29:56 - Example 3: Area of Cycloid Bounded by Its Base
35:05 - Example 3: Parametric Integration & Integration by Parts
39:39 - Inverted Cycloid Concept & Practice Problem
41:09 - Example 4: Common Area Between Parabola ($y^2 = ax$) & Circle ($x^2 + y^2 = 4ax$)
46:50 - Example 4: Setting Up Integration Limits & Splitting Areas
51:15 - Example 4: Standard Trigonometric Integration & Final Solution
56:43 - Summary & Upcoming Topic (Polar Curves)

Agar aapko kisi bhi step me doubt ho toh comment karke zaroor poochiye. Video ko like karein, share karein aur channel ko subscribe karna na bhulein!

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

Master Quadrature & Area Under Curves Step-by-Step  → https://youtu.be/BFbmyUfsFpg

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

Happy Learning! 📐✨
